era: 现代教育时代（1891年安徽歙县贫寒之家—崇一学堂（教会蒙学，'我是一个中国人，应该为中国做出一些贡献来'刻于墙上）—杭州广济医学堂（因不愿入教会而退学）—金陵大学文学系（1910-1914，撰《共和精义》）—哥伦比亚大学师范学院（1914-1915，师从杜威、孟禄、克伯屈）—南京高等师范学校教务主任（1917-1923，把'教授法'改为'教学法'）—与朱其慧、晏阳初等发起中华平民教育促进会（1923）—弃教授之尊办乡村教育：晓庄试验乡村师范（1927，南京郊外破庙起家）—《生活即教育》《教学做合一》系列演讲—山海工学团（1932，上海与宝山之间，小先生制由此发动）—国难教育社与《生活教育》杂志（1936）—出访欧美亚非宣传抗日与大众教育（1936-1938，受杜威等之托为'中国救援'奔走）—育才学校（1939，重庆合川，收容战区难童按才能分组）—社会大学（1946，重庆）—民主教育最后演讲（1946年7月上海，'我等着第三枪'）—1946年7月25日脑溢血逝世于上海：歙县—杭州—金陵—哥大—南京—晓庄—山海—重庆—上海）

style_name: Tao Hsing-chih / H. C. Tao（英文名，哥伦比亚大学注册名）；原名陶文濬，1912年改名陶知行，1934年改名陶行知
courtesy_name: 原名陶文濬（'文浚'取浚明之义）→ 1912年自改名'知行'（服膺王阳明知行合一）→ 1934年再改名'行知'（'行是知之始'），一字之序的颠倒用了二十二年；字世昌（行世少用）
pseudonym: 笔名'行知行'（一度三段式署名以示'行-知-行'循环）、'梧影'、'问江'等；社论与教育通信多署本名，《古庙敲钟录》等文学作品署名'行知'；'捧着一颗心来，不带半根草去'为晓庄封校演说名句
historical_significance: 陶行知（1891-1946），安徽歙县人，中国现代生活教育理论的创立者与实践家。哥伦比亚大学师范学院出身（杜威高足），归国后先任南京高师教务主任，把师范'教授法'课程整体改为'教学法'；1923年投身平民教育运动，1927年弃大学教授之尊在南京郊外一座破庙创办晓庄试验乡村师范——没有围墙、不发文凭、师生同吃同住同开荒，'生活即教育、社会即学校、教学做合一'由此从口号变为可运行的学校。1932年创办山海工学团，发动'小先生制'（即知即传人），让儿童把识字带回家庭邻里，成为中国扫盲运动中性价比最高的制度发明；抗战期间发起国难教育，创办育才学校收容战区难童并按才能分组施教，在最穷的条件下跑通天才儿童教育的制度原型；晚年把毕生理论收束为'民主教育'——教育教人做自己的主人。他三次改名（文濬→知行→行知）以身体认识论转向，'行是知之始，知是行之成'是他对王阳明的镜像翻转。1946年7月25日因脑溢血逝世于上海，年仅55岁，宋庆龄题'万世师表'。毛泽东称'伟大的人民教育家'，董必武称'当今一圣人'。他与晏阳初并称'南陶北晏'——同一时代命题（教育走向人民）的两条互补路线。
unique_thinking: 陶行知的独特贡献是把教育从'学校的专门事务'改写为'生活的存在方式'，并把每一主张都落成可运行的制度：其一，本体论翻转——'生活即教育'把教育从铃声之间的专门活动扩展为人的一生，过什么生活便受什么教育，改进教育先改进生活本身而非课程表；其二，场域扩容——'社会即学校'拆掉围墙，庙宇、茶馆、田间都是教室，学校同时办成社会的公共设施（夜校、医院、茶园），双向流动而非单向索取；其三，知行工程化——'教学做合一'把教、学、做钉死在同一件真实的事上，'在劳力上劳心'，方法从事情的完成条件里长出来而非从教本里套出来；这是王阳明'知行合一'的课堂版。其四，复利式传播——'小先生制'以'即知即传'把学习者变成传播节点，师资按指数而非线性增长，'以教代考'同时是学习判据；其五，行动认识论——'行是知之始'：知识根系于亲历（亲知），闻知说知必须接根，并以三次改名把认识论转向变成公开可监督的承诺；其六，解放工程——'六大解放'（头脑、双手、眼睛、嘴、空间、时间）把创造力问题从禀赋论改写为束缚诊断：解绑先于加码，成组拆除而非点缀式松绑；其七，信托伦理——'捧着一颗心来，不带半根草去'，把教育者定义为受托人，利益冲突不可交易，'你的教鞭下有瓦特'把偏见定义为信托挪用；其八，成就民主化——'人人是创造之人'：评价判据从地位换成'是否解决了此前未解决的问题'，平凡岗位进入成就计算域；其九，反向制度实验——不从部里发文而从一块田办起，以运行代替论证，一切设计必须通过贫困测试；其十，终局综合——'民主教育'把教育与政体互为条件，教人做主人的教育需要终身化，因为民主生活本身需要持续学习。

cross_references.description_zh: 陶行知一生的认识论是与王阳明的两次交割：青年时改名'知行'服膺'知是行之始'，中年在晓庄的实践中发现方向相反——认识从行动的遭遇中来而非从静观中来——于是改名'行知'，用二十二年把阳明命题镜像翻转。但翻转不是否定：'教学做合一'是'知行合一'的课堂工程版，'劳力上劳心'保留了阳明对'冥行妄作'与'悬空思索'的双重批判。分野在于：阳明在心学内部解决个人'知而不行'的病，陶把它扩展为制度——学校怎么编、教师怎么教、文凭认什么。对照链：M-TXZ-005（行是知之始）× M382（知行合一法）——同一命题的心性版与课堂版；M-TXZ-003（教学做合一）× 阳明'事上磨练'——'事'的教育学化。

cross_references.description_zh: 陶行知是杜威在哥伦比亚大学的中国弟子，但他的三句核心命题全部是对师说的倒置：杜威说'教育即生活'，从学校出发把生活引进来；陶说'生活即教育'，从生活出发把学校送出去。杜威说'学校即社会'——在学校里模拟一个社会；陶说'社会即学校'——把真社会直接当学校，不要仿真。杜威说'从做中学'（learning by doing），做是教法；陶说'在劳力上劳心'，做是认识论——行动产生知识而非 merely 巩固知识。倒置的动力来自场景落差：杜威的实验学校面对芝加哥中产儿童，陶面对的是失学的四万万农民——当学习者的第一需要是识字与生计，'预备'论立即破产，教育必须是生活本身。对照链：M-TXZ-001（生活即教育）× 杜威'教育即生活'；M-TXZ-002（社会即学校）× 杜威'学校即社会'——三组镜像各成一对。

modes.name_en: Life Is Education: Rewriting the Ontology of Learning
modes.definition_zh: 陶行知的元命题是把教育的本体从'学校里的传授'改写为'生活本身'：'生活即教育，是生活便是教育，不是生活便不是教育。'这不是修辞夸张而是本体论翻转——教育不再是一个发生在特定时刻特定地点的专门活动，而是生活的固有属性：过什么生活便受什么教育，过好的生活便受好的教育，过奋斗的生活便受奋斗的教育。方法论签名有三：其一，连续性判别——教育不在上课铃与下课铃之间，而在人处理饮食、劳作、交往、危机的全部时间里，因此'教育规划'实质是'生活规划'；其二，质量等价律——生活的品质即教育的品质，想改进教育先改进被生活者所过的生活内容，而非先改课程表；其三，反预备论——杜威'教育是生活的预备'被倒转为'教育是生活的本身'，他批评中国教育'先读书后做事'是把人生切成两段：先死读十几年再用不出去。这一模式为后续一切主张（社会即学校、教学做合一、小先生制）提供了存在论地基：凡教育必在生活之中，凡生活皆可成教育。
modes.definition_en: Tao Xingzhi's master proposition rewrites the ontology of education from 'instruction delivered inside schools' to 'life itself': 'Life is education — whatever is life is education; whatever is not life is not education.' This is not rhetoric but an ontological inversion: education is no longer a special activity confined to a special time and place, but an inherent property of living — to live a certain life is to receive a certain education; to live a good life is to receive a good education; to live a striving life is to receive an education in striving. Three signatures define the mode. First, the continuity criterion: education does not run between bells; it runs through everything a person does with food, work, association, and crisis — so 'planning education' is in substance 'planning life.' Second, the quality-equivalence law: the quality of the life lived IS the quality of the education received; to improve education, first improve the content of the life being lived, not the timetable. Third, anti-preparationism: Dewey's 'education as preparation for life' is inverted into 'education as life itself' — Tao attacked the Chinese schooling that said 'read for a dozen years first, act later,' slicing a human life into two halves, the second spent unable to use the first. The mode grounds everything that follows — society as school, unity of teaching-learning-doing, the little-teacher system — on one ontological base: all education lives inside life, and all life can become education.
modes.source_chapter: 陶行知《生活即教育》（1929年晓庄演讲）；《生活教育》一文；湘湖教学讨论中的'生活教育'定义

process_zh: 审计学习者的真实生活清单：先列出对象每天实际在过的'生活'（劳作、消费、交往、闲逛），承认这些已经是教育——不承认这一点，一切改造都刻在错误的地基上
做质量对照：把'想要的教育'与'正在过的生活'逐项对照，找出生活内容与教育目标背离之处——背离处即真问题，课程表不是
改生活而非改课表：优先改造生活内容本身（劳动的安排、共同体的规则、环境的材料），使生活在被改进的同时完成教育
建立生活-教育回路：让生活中的成果与失败直接进入集体复盘，不断把'过的生活'升级为'更好的生活'——教育因此永不下课
process_en: Audit the learner's actual life: list what the person really does daily — labor, consumption, association, idling — and admit these already ARE education; refusing this admitance builds every reform on the wrong foundation.
Run the quality comparison: set the 'education you want' against the 'life being lived,' item by item; the divergences are the real problems — not the timetable.

Change the life, not the schedule: first reshape the content of living itself — arrangements of work, rules of the community, materials of the environment — so that improving the life IS delivering the education.
Close the life-education loop: feed the outcomes and failures of living directly into collective retrospection, upgrading the life lived into a better life — education thereby never recesses.
representative_cases_zh: 1927年晓庄师范：学校没有围墙、不发文凭，师生开荒、盖房、办民众夜校、成立自卫队——'村生活即校生活'，整座村庄就是课程；陶行知自任校长的第一课是带学生挑粪种地
山海工学团（1932）：把工厂、学校、田园合成一体，'工以养生、学以明生、团以保生'——儿童上午做工下午学习，学习内容直接来自当日生产中的问题
反面警示：陶行知讽刺旧学校是'鸟笼式教育'——把生活关在门外，教出来的学生'读死书、死读书、读书死'；他点名批评的正是那些课程表精致而生活内容空虚的名牌学堂：教育的质量等价于生活的质量，生活虚空则教育无论排得多满都是零
representative_cases_en: Xiaozhuang Normal School, 1927: no walls, no diplomas; teachers and students opened wasteland, built houses, ran night schools, organized self-defense — 'the village's life is the school's life'; Tao's first lesson as principal was carrying manure with the students.

Shanhai Work-Study Corps, 1932: factory, school, and farmland fused as one — 'work to live, learning to understand life, the corps to protect life'; children worked mornings and studied afternoons on problems drawn from that day's production.

Cautionary counterexample: Tao mocked the old school as 'birdcage education' — life locked outside, graduates who 'read dead books, read books to death, die reading.' His named target was precisely the prestigious academy with an exquisite timetable and an empty life: education's quality equals the quality of the life lived; where life is hollow, however packed the schedule, the education is zero.
modern_applications_zh: 企业培训改革：先审计员工'真实工作生活'里已经发生的学习（踩坑、救火、带人），把它显性化为课程，而不是另造一套脱产课件
家庭教育的质量等价律：想让孩子成长先改家庭生活内容（共读、共劳、共议），而非先报班——报班是改课表，不是改生活
社区营造：把社区实际问题（垃圾分类、适老化、儿童放学）设计为居民共同处理的生活项目，治理与教育一体完成
个人学习复盘：不做'想学什么'清单，先做'正在过什么生活'清单——目标生活与当前生活的差距才是真正该学的
modern_applications_en: Corporate training: audit the learning already happening inside employees' real working life (mistakes, firefighting, mentoring) and make it explicit curriculum, instead of building separate off-the-job courseware.

Family education by the quality-equivalence law: to grow the child, first change the content of family life (reading, labor, deliberation together) rather than first booking classes — classes change the timetable, not the life.
Community building: design real neighborhood problems (waste sorting, elder-friendliness, after-school children) as shared life projects of residents — governance and education completed in one act.
Personal retrospection: skip the 'what should I learn' list; list 'what life am I actually living' — the gap between the life you want and the life you live is the true curriculum.

modes.name_zh: 社会即学校场域扩容法
modes.name_en: Society as School: Expanding the Field of Education
modes.definition_zh: 如果说'生活即教育'回答了教育是什么，'社会即学校'回答了教育在哪里：陶行知要把学校四堵墙拆掉，把整个社会变成学习的场域——'要把学校的围墙拆去，把社会作学校'。方法论签名有三：其一，资源重估——庙宇、祠堂、茶馆、店铺、田间、军队都是现成的教室与教具，办学的第一问题不是'到哪里找校舍'而是'到哪里圈禁生活'；其二，边界成本论证——围墙内的教育是'鸟世界'，飞进社会的'鸟的世界'才见真风雨，围墙同时圈禁了教材（真实问题）与师资（各行各业的实践者）；其三，双向流动设计——不是学校单向'利用'社会，而是把学校办成社会的发动机：晓庄的民众夜校、中心茶园、乡村医院同时是村庄的公共设施，学校越开放，社会越受益，社会受益后反过来供给学校更多真实课题。这一模式与晏阳初'三大方式'同向而几何不同：晏以'县'为覆盖单位做平面铺开，陶以'学校-社会'边界消融做体积渗透——教育不再是社会的子系统，而是社会自身的存在方式。
modes.definition_en: If 'life is education' answers what education is, 'society as school' answers where it happens: Tao wanted the four walls of school demolished and the whole society turned into the field of learning — 'tear down the school's walls and take society as the school.' Three signatures define the mode. First, resource revaluation: temples, ancestral halls, teahouses, shops, fields, and barracks are ready-made classrooms and teaching aids; the first question of starting a school is not 'where do we find a building' but 'where do we wall off life.' Second, the boundary-cost argument: education inside walls is 'a bird's world in a cage'; only flying into the birds' true world meets real weather — the wall cages up both the teaching materials (genuine problems) and the faculty (practitioners of every trade). Third, two-way flow design: the school does not one-way 'exploit' society; the school is run as society's engine — Xiaozhuang's night schools, central teahouse, and rural clinic were at once the village's public infrastructure; the more open the school, the more society gains, and the enriched society in turn supplies the school with richer real problems. The mode points the same way as Yan Yangchu's 'three approaches' but with a different geometry: Yan spread coverage planar across the county; Tao dissolved the school-society boundary into volumetric permeation — education ceases to be a subsystem of society and becomes society's own mode of existence.
modes.source_chapter: 陶行知《社会即学校》系列论述；晓庄师范办学章程与《中国乡村教育之根本改造》（1926）
process_zh: 清点围墙内外的教育资产：把'学校拥有什么'与'社会已拥有什么'两张清单并列，标出被围墙隔绝的教材、师资、场地
选择社会节点办学：在茶馆、店铺、庙宇、田头等人群自然聚集处布点，让学校出现在生活的必经之路上，而非要求生活绕路来学校
设计双向服务：每一教学点必须同时回答'学员从这里学到什么'与'社区从这里得到什么'——单向索取的办学在乡村必然枯萎
拆除制度围墙：把注册、课时、文凭改成可携带的记录与展示，让在社会中的学习成果能被承认、积累与流转
process_en: Inventory educational assets inside and outside the wall: set the 'what the school owns' list against 'what society already owns,' marking the teaching materials, faculty, and venues cut off by the wall.

Site the school on social nodes: place teaching points where people already gather — teahouses, shops, temples, field edges — so the school sits on life's beaten path instead of demanding that life detour to school.
Design two-way service: every teaching point must answer both 'what do learners gain here' and 'what does the community gain here' — extractive schools wither in the village.
Dismantle institutional walls: convert registration, seat time, and diplomas into portable records and demonstrations, so learning done in society can be recognized, accumulated, and transferred.
representative_cases_zh: 晓庄师范把招生广告贴到茶馆与庙会，'学问在田野'——学校以一座破庙起家，课堂设在山上田间，医院的病人、茶园的茶客、自卫队的操练全部成了教学现场
工学团的'小小先生'讲课就开在村民家里与店铺柜台边——学习地点随生活地点走，教材随生活问题走，学校成了一张网而不是一栋楼
反面警示：同时期一些'乡村教育'试验把城市校舍整套搬到乡下，围墙依旧、铃声依旧，村民只在'开放日'被请来参观——场域没有变，只是地点变了；陶行知批评这是'穿长衫的下乡'：把社会的学校办成了学校的社会仿真
representative_cases_en: Xiaozhuang Normal posted its recruitment ads in teahouses and temple fairs — 'learning is in the fields'; the school began with one ruined temple, held classes on hillsides and in fields, and turned clinic patients, teahouse regulars, and militia drills into living classrooms.

Work-study corps 'little teachers' held lessons in villagers' homes and beside shop counters — the venue followed the living site, the materials followed the living problem, and the school became a network, not a building.

Cautionary counterexample: some 'rural education' experiments of the era transplanted the entire urban campus to the countryside — walls intact, bells intact, villagers invited in only on open days. The venue changed; the field did not. Tao called this 'going to the village in long gowns': a school of society turned into a simulated society of school.
modern_applications_zh: 企业大学去地产化：把培训从教室搬到客户现场、生产线、危机复盘会——真实业务节点即分校
城市学习型社区：图书馆、菜场、公园、地铁站点位化布设学习触点，'15分钟学习圈'取代集中式校区
线上教育反围墙：把课程嵌入工作流（边做边学的提示、复盘模板），而非要求用户离开工作进入'网校'——网校常是数字化的鸟笼
职业教育双元制深化：学徒的考核场景直接放在岗位真实交付物上，企业车间是学校，学校车间是企业
modern_applications_en: De-realestate the corporate university: move training from classrooms to customer sites, production lines, and incident retrospectives — real business nodes are the branch campuses.
Learning cities: distribute learning touchpoints across libraries, markets, parks, and metro stations — a '15-minute learning circle' replacing the centralized campus.

Tearing down the digital wall: embed courses inside the workflow (in-task hints, retrospective templates) instead of asking users to leave work for an 'online school' — which is too often the birdcage digitized.
Deepening dual vocational training: assess apprentices on real job deliverables; the workshop is the school and the school workshop is the enterprise.

modes.key_quote_en: Tear down the school's walls and take society as the school: only when the space is liberated does education gain its full force.

modes.name_en: Unity of Teaching, Learning, Doing: One Process, Not Three
modes.domain_en: Education / Method of Knowledge and Action
modes.definition_zh: 陶行知的方法论枢纽是把教学做从三件事改写为一件事的三面：'事怎样做便怎样学，怎样学便怎样教；学的法子根据做的法子，教的法子根据学的法子。'判据是'在做上教，在做上学'——'做'是中心，含'在劳力上劳心'二义：单纯劳力是蛮干，单纯劳心是空想，真做是手脑并用。方法论签名有三：其一，对象统一——教的对象、学的对象、做的对象必须是同一件真实的事，一旦教师教课本、学生学课本、而事在别处，三者立刻分裂为三种表演；其二，以事定法——方法不从教本里来，从事情本身的完成条件里来，种田教学法从种田里长出来，而不是先有'教学法'再去套种田；其三，劳力上劳心——把'行动'与'思想'焊死在同一个动作里：动手之前必先想，动手之后必复盘，'做'由此区别于盲动，成为认识的发生器。这一模式是对王阳明'知行合一'的工程化改写：阳明在心学内部解决'知而不行只是未知'，陶把它落成可操作的教学组织——知行合一是心性命题，教学做合一是课堂命题。
modes.definition_en: The hinge of Tao's method is to rewrite teaching, learning, and doing from three activities into three faces of one activity: 'As the thing is done, so it is learned; as it is learned, so it is taught; the method of learning follows the method of doing, and the method of teaching follows the method of learning.' The criterion: teach on doing, learn on doing — and 'doing' is the center, carrying the double meaning of 'thinking within laboring': labor without thought is blind drudgery, thought without labor is empty fantasy; true doing works with hand and mind at once. Three signatures define the mode. First, object unity: what is taught, what is learned, and what is done must be the same real thing — the moment the teacher teaches the textbook, the student studies the textbook, while the matter itself sits elsewhere, the three split into three performances. Second, method from the matter: method does not come from pedagogy books but from the completion-conditions of the thing itself — a pedagogy of farming grows out of farming, not out of 'pedagogy' applied onto farming. Third, thinking within laboring: weld action and thought into one gesture — think before the hand moves, review after it moves — so that 'doing' is distinguished from blind motion and becomes a generator of knowledge. The mode is Tao's engineering rewrite of Wang Yangming's 'unity of knowledge and action': Yangming solved 'to know and not act is simply not to know' within philosophy of mind; Tao lands it as an operable organization of teaching — Yangming's is a proposition of the heart-mind, Tao's a proposition of the classroom.
modes.source_chapter: 陶行知《教学做合一》（1927年晓庄演讲）；《在劳力上劳心》；《中国乡村教育之根本改造》
process_zh: 选定'真事'作单元核心：每一学习单元必须锚定一件真实可完成的事（种一畦菜、修一座桥、完成一次真实交易），禁止以'讲完某章'为单元目标
以事的完成条件反推学法：把'做成它需要会什么'列成清单，学法按此清单组织——教材是事的附录，不是事的替身
劳力上劳心的双钩检查：每个动手环节前后各设一个思维钩子——动手前预测与方案、动手后对照与复盘，缺一钩即退化为蛮干
教法随学法随做法：教师不下发统一进度，而是随各人做事的当下问题给教——教的节奏服从做的节奏
process_en: Anchor every unit on a real task: each learning unit must pin to one genuinely completable matter — grow a bed of vegetables, repair a bridge, close a real transaction; 'finished chapter X' is banned as a unit goal.

Derive the learning method from the task's completion conditions: list 'what one must be able to do to finish it' and organize learning along that list — the textbook is the task's appendix, never its stand-in.

Double-hook the thinking-within-laboring: before and after every hands-on step set one thinking hook — prediction and plan beforehand, comparison and retrospective after; missing either hook degrades doing into drudgery.
Let teaching follow learning follow doing: no uniform pacing handed down; the teacher teaches into each person's live problem in the doing — teaching's rhythm obeys doing's rhythm.
representative_cases_zh: 晓庄的农事课：学生种的是真田、卖的是真粮、账是真账——收成好坏即成绩单；陶行知要求教师'跟学生一起做'，不会种田的先拜农人为师
工学团里儿童学的算术从工分与账目中来，学的文字从工合同与家信中来——同一件'做'同时供给了算术与识字的教学内容
反面警示：陶行知批评当时师范教育的'教授法'——师范生学的是'怎样讲书'而非'怎样做事'，毕业后把死讲又传给下一代；他任教务主任时干脆把'教授法'科目改名'教学法'再整体废弃，只因名不改则实不改：三事分裂的教学越认真，越高效地生产无用
representative_cases_en: Agriculture at Xiaozhuang: students farmed real fields, sold real grain, kept real accounts — the harvest was the report card; Tao required teachers to 'do alongside the students,' and a teacher who could not farm first apprenticed to a peasant.
In the work-study corps, children's arithmetic came from work-points and ledgers, their literacy from labor contracts and family letters — one 'doing' supplied the content for both subjects.

Cautionary counterexample: Tao attacked normal-school 'professorial method' — trainees learned 'how to lecture on books,' not 'how to do things,' then passed dead lecturing to the next generation; as dean he renamed the subject 'teaching method' and then abolished it wholesale, for without renaming the substance never changed: the more diligently the three activities split, the more efficiently they produced the useless.
modern_applications_zh: 项目制课程审计：检查每个'项目'是否锚定真实交付物——伪项目（为展示而做的海报）在三事分裂判定下不合格
带教学徒的双钩法：上岗前做预测与方案陈述，收工后做对照复盘——只干不想或只想不干都判未完成
管理培训以事定法：废除'通用领导力课件'，从本组织真实决策难题反推该教什么——课件是事的附录
个人技能学习：以'做成一件真事'为单元（发布一个真实产品），反对'先学完再动手'的两段式人生
modern_applications_en: Project-based course audit: check whether every 'project' anchors a real deliverable — pseudo-projects (posters made for display) fail the three-splits test.

The double hook in apprenticeship: a forecast and plan stated before taking up the task, a comparison and retrospective after; working without thinking or thinking without working both count as incomplete.
Management training by method-from-the-matter: abolish generic leadership courseware; derive what to teach from this organization's real decision problems — courseware is the matter's appendix.
Personal skill acquisition: take 'finish one real thing' (ship an actual product) as the unit, against the two-half life of 'learn it all first, act later.'

modes.key_quote_zh: 事怎样做便怎样学，怎样学便怎样教；学的法子根据做的法子，教的法子根据学的法子。
modes.key_quote_en: As the thing is done, so it is learned; as it is learned, so it is taught: the method of learning follows the method of doing, and the method of teaching follows the method of learning.

modes.name_en: The Little Teacher: Transmit the Moment You Know
modes.definition_zh: 面对师资与校舍永远赶不上文盲数量的算术困境，陶行知的解法是把学习者本身变成传播节点：'即知即传人'——学到一点，立刻教给别人；儿童放学回家教母亲与邻里，一个小先生一个月能带动数人识字。方法论签名有三：其一，复利式扩张——师资不再按线性增长，按指数复制，一名教师培训三十个小先生即得三十个教学点，这是把网络增长的数学引入教育供给；其二，以教代考——教别人才是学会的最终判据（后世'费曼技巧'的同构物），小先生讲解不通处即自己未懂处，'即知即传'因而同时是学习法；其三，身份反转的激励设计——给最没有地位的人（儿童、妇女、学徒）以'先生'之名，尊严重建本身就是最便宜的教育动员：'小先生'不是师资不足的将就，而是把'教'重新定义为每个人公民身份的一部分。这一模式与晏阳初'导生制'同源而传播半径更大：导生仍以辅助教师为限，小先生则把家庭与邻里变成正规课堂——中国扫盲史上性价比最高的制度发明之一。
modes.definition_en: Facing the arithmetic trap that teachers and schoolhouses can never catch up with the illiterate millions, Tao's solution was to turn learners themselves into transmission nodes: 'transmit the moment you know' — learn a little, immediately teach it to someone else; a child goes home from school and teaches mother and neighbors, and one little teacher can pull several people into literacy each month. Three signatures define the mode. First, compound expansion: teacher supply no longer grows linearly but replicates exponentially — one teacher training thirty little teachers yields thirty teaching posts; this is network-growth mathematics imported into the supply of education. Second, teaching as the final test: only by teaching another is learning certified (the isomorph of the later 'Feynman technique'); where the little teacher's explanation jams is exactly where understanding fails — 'transmit as you know' is thus simultaneously a learning method. Third, incentive by identity reversal: confer the title 'teacher' on those with the least standing — children, women, apprentices — and the reconstruction of dignity becomes the cheapest mobilization of all: the little teacher is not a makeshift for teacher shortage but a redefinition of 'teaching' as part of every person's citizenship. The mode shares a root with Yan Yangchu's student-teacher system but with a longer transmission radius: the student-teacher still assists the master, while the little teacher turns home and neighborhood into regular classrooms — one of the highest-yield institutional inventions in the history of Chinese literacy.
modes.source_chapter: 陶行知《小先生与普及教育》（1934）；《怎样做小先生》；山海工学团小先生实践记录
process_zh: 算清供给缺口：先做师资-需求缺口测算，确认线性供给不可行——这一步不可省，它决定'必须借学习者扩张'的结论不是理念偏好而是算术必然
以教任务固化学习：每位学习者领一个'教的任务'（教会家里一人、教会邻家一人），把传播写进学习闭环而非可选项
给身份给工具：授予'小先生'名号与简单教具（识字牌、千字课），并教其最简教学法——重点是'敢教'而非'教好'
以教验学并回炉：以学员能否教会他人为学会判据，教不动处回炉重学；教会成果登记造册，形成复利台账
process_en: Do the supply-gap arithmetic: measure the teacher-demand gap first and confirm linear supply is infeasible — this step cannot be skipped, for it makes 'expanding through learners' an arithmetical necessity, not an ideological preference.

Fix a teaching task into the learning loop: every learner is assigned a 'task of teaching' (teach one at home, teach one next door) — transmission enters the closed loop as a requirement, not an option.

Grant identity and tools: confer the 'little teacher' title with simple aids (literacy cards, thousand-character lessons) and the simplest teaching method — the point is 'dare to teach,' not 'teach perfectly.'

Certify learning by teaching: whether the learner can teach another is the test of having learned; where teaching jams, return to re-learning; register each successful transmission in a compounding ledger.
representative_cases_zh: 山海工学团的小先生运动：学生张健等放学后教家人邻里，数月内一个村子的识字点从一处扩散到数十处；陶行知把'一传十、十传百'的台账当作运动的成绩单
小先生救国宣传：抗战中'小先生'同时承担识字与国难宣传，儿童登台讲演、办壁报——即知即传不止于识字，扩展为公共传播能力培养
反面警示：也有地方把小先生办成'免费劳动力'——儿童被派去代写文书、代管账目而无人督导教学，家长随之抵制；陶行知亲自立规：小先生必须先完成自己功课、必须在成人教师巡回督导下施教——扩张若丢掉质量控制，复利会变成倒雪崩
representative_cases_en: The little-teacher movement at the Shanhai corps: students such as Zhang Jian taught family and neighbors after class; within months one village's literacy points spread from one to dozens — Tao treated the 'one-begets-ten' ledger as the movement's report card.

Little teachers in wartime: they carried both literacy and national-crisis propaganda — children gave public speeches and ran wall newspapers; 'transmit as you know' extended from literacy to public communication.

Cautionary counterexample: some locales turned little teachers into free labor — children dispatched to write documents and keep accounts with no pedagogical supervision, until parents pushed back. Tao himself set the rule: a little teacher must first complete his own lessons and teach only under itinerant adult supervision — expansion without quality control turns compound interest into an avalanche in reverse.
modern_applications_zh: 企业内训'学后必教'：每名受训员工结业后须带教一名新人并留下可复用讲义——训练预算的指数化
开源社区即知即传：贡献者修完一个 bug 即写教程或录演示，以'能教会他人'作为代码评审外的第二道关卡
家庭数字反哺制度化：把'晚辈教长辈用手机'设计成固定仪式与任务清单，而非随缘发生
学习社群的传教式扩张：会员资格与'至少教会一人'绑定，社群增长由学习成果驱动而非营销投放
modern_applications_en: Corporate 'must-teach-after-learning': every trainee, on completion, mentors one newcomer and leaves a reusable handout — exponentiating the training budget.
Open-source transmit-as-you-know: a contributor who fixes a bug writes a tutorial or records a demo; 'can you teach it' becomes a second review gate beyond code review.
Institutionalized digital reverse-mentoring: design 'the young teach the elders the smartphone' as a fixed ritual with task lists, not a matter of chance.
Missionary growth of learning communities: membership bound to 'teach at least one other person' — growth driven by learning outcomes, not marketing spend.

modes.key_quote_en: Transmit the moment you know: whoever will not teach does not truly know. The little teacher is not only the instrument of universal education but the vanguard of the nation's renewal.

modes.name_en: Action Is the Beginning of Knowledge: The Epistemology of Action-First
modes.definition_zh: 陶行知三次改名的一生（文濬→知行→行知）压缩了他的认识论转向：青年服膺王阳明'知是行之始'，中年在实践中发现真相相反——'行是知之始，知是行之成'：认识不从书本与静观中来，而从行动的遭遇中来；行动产生真知，真知反过来指导行动，循环上升。方法论签名有三：其一，遭遇优先——知识的原初形态不是命题而是'碰壁'：烫过手才知道火烫，尝过甘草才知道甜，'亲知'是一切知识的根系，'闻知'（听来的）与'说知'（推想的）必须接在亲知的根上才能活；其二，改名作为自我审计——当实践与既有信念冲突时，他不修补论证而改写自己的名号，把认识论转向变成公开的、可监督的承诺装置；其三，行动的证据标准——检验一个人真知还是假知，不看他的主张而看他的行动史：主张儿童中心而课堂里全是讲授，即证其未知。这一模式把王阳明的命题做了一次镜像翻转：阳明由知而行的困难在'知而不行'，陶由行而知的困难在'不行而伪知'——对纸面知识时代的诊断尤为锋利。
modes.definition_en: Tao's three renamings in one life (Wenjun → Zhixing → Xingzhi) compress his epistemological turn. Young, he followed Wang Yangming's 'knowledge is the beginning of action'; in practice he found the truth runs the other way — 'action is the beginning of knowledge, and knowledge the completion of action': knowledge originates not in books or contemplation but in the collisions of acting; action yields true knowledge, and true knowledge in turn steers action, an ascending cycle. Three signatures define the mode. First, priority of encounter: knowledge's primal form is not the proposition but the rebuff — only a burned hand knows the burn, only a tasted tongue the licorice; 'personally known' is the root system of all knowledge, and 'heard knowledge' and 'inferred knowledge' survive only when grafted onto that root. Second, renaming as self-audit: when practice contradicted his creed, he did not patch the argument — he changed his own name, converting an epistemological turn into a public, supervisable commitment device. Third, the evidentiary standard of action: to test whether a person truly knows, read not his claims but his action-history — one who professes child-centeredness while lecturing through every class has thereby proven he does not know. The mode is a mirror inversion of Wang Yangming: Yangming's difficulty, moving from knowledge to action, was 'knowing yet not acting'; Tao's, moving from action to knowledge, is 'not acting yet pseudo-knowing' — a diagnosis never sharper than in an age of paper knowledge.
modes.source_chapter: 陶行知《行是知之始》（1927）；《伪知识阶级》；自述三次改名缘由的书信与演讲
process_zh: 清点知识的根系来源：对任一'自以为知道'的命题追问——我是否亲历过它？若全是闻知与说知，标注为'纸面知识'并降级其可信度权重
安排遭遇性检验：把纸面知识投进真实行动里接受碰撞——计划本身不重要，计划撞上现实产生的反例才重要
公开改写承诺：当行动反例推翻既有信念时，不私下调整，而以公开可见的方式改写立场（改名、公开声明、重写章程），让认识论转向可被监督
以行动史验人：评估他人主张时调取其行动记录——言行背离处即伪知，禁止以言辞更新替代行动更新
process_en: Audit the root source of each claim: for anything you 'believe you know,' ask — have I personally encountered it? If it is all heard or inferred, tag it 'paper knowledge' and downgrade its credence weight.

Stage an encounter test: throw the paper knowledge into real action to take its collisions — the plan itself matters little; the counterexamples the plan begets on contact with reality matter everything.

Rewrite commitments in public: when an action-counterexample overturns a belief, do not adjust privately — rewrite your position in publicly visible form (a new name, a declaration, a rewritten charter), making the epistemological turn supervisable.

Judge people by action-history: in assessing anyone's claims, pull their record of deeds; where word and deed diverge lies pseudo-knowledge — never accept verbal updates as substitutes for behavioral ones.
representative_cases_zh: 三次改名的实证：1912年取名'知行'服膺阳明；1934年正式改名'行知'并公开声明'行是知之始'——一次个人命名成为全国教育界的认识论公共事件
《伪知识阶级》的火力：他批评靠引经据典吃饭的'伪知识'阶层，称纸上得来的知识若无亲知之根即是'伪知识'——考据再精也不产生对世界的新认识
反面警示：他讽刺自己早年在南京高专教课照本宣科的岁月——'那时我知识很多，行动很少，其实是无知的'；反过来，未读过书的农人在田里的判断常比留学生准，因为他们的知识全部接在亲知的根上：这是对'学历幻觉'最早的系统批判之一
representative_cases_en: The renamings as evidence: in 1912 he took the name 'Zhixing' (knowledge-action) under Yangming's banner; in 1934 he formally renamed himself 'Xingzhi' (action-knowledge), declaring 'action is the beginning of knowledge' — one man's renaming became a public epistemological event for Chinese education.

The fire of 'The Class of Pseudo-Knowledge': he attacked the class that lives by citing classics — book-derived knowledge without roots in personal experience is pseudo-knowledge; however refined the erudition, it yields no new knowledge of the world.

Cautionary counterexample: he mocked his own early years lecturing from the textbook at Nanjing — 'then I had much knowledge and little action; in truth I was ignorant.' Conversely, the unschooled farmer's judgments in the field often beat the returned student's, because the farmer's knowledge is grafted wholly onto the root of personal encounter — among the earliest systematic critiques of the credential illusion.
modern_applications_zh: 组织决策的亲知审计：重要战略主张须附'决策者亲历证据'——未去过一线的高管对一线的判断一律标注低置信度
产品认知以发布为界：未上线的功能设计一律算'说知'，只有真实用户行为产生的认知才算'亲知'——路线图让位于实验
个人知识管理：区分'读过'与'做过'两套标签，引用观点时同时声明根系来源——警告自己不转发未亲历者的断言
专家评估的行动史核查：聘请顾问或评估专家主张时，调取其可验证的行动记录而非论著清单
modern_applications_en: Root-source audit in decisions: major strategic claims must attach the decider's first-hand evidence; executives' judgments about the frontline they never visited carry a low-credence tag.
Ship as the epistemic boundary: unreleased feature designs count as 'inferred knowledge'; only cognition from real user behavior counts as 'personally known' — roadmaps yield to experiments.
Personal knowledge management: tag every item 'read' vs 'done'; when citing a view, declare its root source — and refuse to forward assertions from the unexperienced.
Action-history vetting of experts: when hiring advisors or weighing expert claims, pull verifiable records of deeds, not lists of publications.

王阳明（被镜像翻转的前身）
杜威（经验主义认识论的来源）
墨子（'士虽有学而行为本焉'的古典先声）
modes.key_quote_zh: 行是知之始，知是行之成——行动是老子，知识是儿子，创造是孙子。
modes.key_quote_en: Action is the beginning of knowledge, and knowledge the completion of action: action is the grandfather, knowledge the father, creation the child.

modes.name_en: The Six Liberations: Unleashing the Whole Person
modes.domain_zh: 教育学/创造力条件设计
modes.definition_zh: 面对'中国为什么出不了创造性人才'之问，陶行知的答案不是增加课程而是拆除束缚：儿童的创造力被'裹头布'层层缠住，解放之法是'六大解放'——解放儿童的头脑（使能想）、双手（使能干）、眼睛（使能看）、嘴（使能谈）、空间（使到大自然大社会去）、时间（使学自己想学的东西）。方法论签名有三：其一，约束诊断先于供给思维——创造力不足不是资源不够而是束缚过多，改革的第一动作是解绑而非加码，这与'多投钱多开课'的常规思路恰好相反；其二，束缚的系统性——六项束缚互相支撑（无时间则头脑双手皆闲，无空间则眼睛无处可看），必须成组拆除，只解放一项会被其余五项吞没；其三，自由的方向性——解放不是放任，'六大解放'全部指向创造的出口：想出来要说，说出来要做，做了要去看结果——它是一套'为创造而组织自由'的工程学。这一模式把儿童从'被教育的对象'最终翻转为'创造的主体'，是生活教育理论的完成态。
modes.definition_en: Asked why China produced so few creative talents, Tao's answer was not more curriculum but fewer bindings: children's creativity is wound in layer after layer of head-cloths, and liberation means the 'six liberations' — free the child's head (to think), hands (to do), eyes (to see), mouth (to speak), space (to go into nature and the great society), and time (to learn what one wants to learn). Three signatures define the mode. First, binding-diagnosis before supply-thinking: a deficit of creativity is not a shortage of resources but an excess of restraints, so the first move of reform is unbinding, not intensifying — the exact inverse of the reflex to spend more and schedule more. Second, systemic binding: the six restraints brace one another (no time leaves head and hands idle; no space leaves the eyes nothing to see), so they must be dismantled as a set — freeing one alone is swallowed by the other five. Third, the directedness of freedom: liberation is not license; all six point at the exit of creation — what is thought must be said, what is said must be done, what is done must be checked against results — an engineering of 'freedom organized for creation.' The mode flips the child at last from object of education to subject of creation, the completed state of the life-education theory.
modes.source_chapter: 陶行知《创造的儿童教育》（1944）；《小学教师与民主运动》中'六大解放'节；育才学校实践
process_zh: 编制束缚清单：逐项审计儿童/成员的头脑、双手、眼睛、嘴、空间、时间各被什么占据（填鸭课业、禁令、日程、监控），写出六行束缚表
成组解绑：禁止只解放单项的'点缀式改革'——六项必须同时松绑并互相配套（给了时间就必须同时给空间与允许发问）
给创造以出口：解绑的同时铺设出口通道——想法有处讲、动手有材料、成果有展台，使被解放的能量流进创造而非流入新的无聊
复盘再诊断：解放一段时间后重查六项，束缚常以新形式回来（形式上自由、事实上被考试牵着走），按表再拆
process_en: Draw up the binding inventory: audit, item by item, what occupies the head, hands, eyes, mouth, space, and time of the child or member (cram course, prohibitions, schedule, surveillance) — a six-row table of bindings.
Unbind as a set: no ornamental reform freeing a single item — all six must loosen together and in coordination (time granted must come with space granted and questioning permitted).

Build the exit of creation: alongside unbinding, lay the channels out — somewhere to speak the idea, materials to work the hands, a stage for the results — so liberated energy flows into creation, not into a new boredom.
Re-diagnose on review: after a season, re-audit the six; bindings return in new forms (formally free, in fact led by the exam) — take the table and dismantle again.
representative_cases_zh: 育才学校按'六大解放'办：学生自己办墙报、办音乐会、下乡演出与调查——头脑双手眼睛嘴同时开着，创造直接面向社会观众而非考卷
他对教师的要求从'讲课'改为'提供创造的条件'：教师把问题交给学生做、把工具交给学生用、把时间还给学生支配，自己退居'协助创造'的位置
反面警示：他讽刺'成绩单儿童'——六项束缚全在而单项奖励照发：允许'自由活动一小时'但时间被作业塞满、空间被教室圈定、发问被进度打断——这是解放的仿制品；真解放的判据是儿童在做什么，不是学校允许了什么
representative_cases_en: Yucai School run on the six liberations: students ran their own wall newspapers and concerts, went down to villages to perform and investigate — head, hands, eyes, and mouth all open, with creation facing a social audience instead of an exam paper.

His requirement on teachers changed from 'lecturing' to 'supplying the conditions of creation': hand the problem to students, hand over the tools, return their time, and retreat into the role of assisting creation.

Cautionary counterexample: he mocked the 'report-card child' — all six bindings in place while single-item rewards continue: an 'hour of free activity' whose time is stuffed with homework, whose space is the classroom's four walls, whose questions are cut off by the pacing plan — a counterfeit of liberation. The test of true liberation is what the child is doing, not what the school permits.
modern_applications_zh: 组织创新审计：用六项解放表审计团队——想（被KPI占据）、做（无实验权限）、看（不见用户）、说（无发声渠道）、空间（不出工位）、时间（被会议塞满），逐项松绑
儿童课余设计：先做'束缚清单'再报兴趣班——报班若新增束缚（又一节课业），即与解放背道而驰
研发管理的'实验权限'：把动手做实验、见客户、支配20%时间写成制度性解放，配套成果展示通道
个人创造力自查：六项自查——头脑输入是否单一、双手是否久不动、眼睛是否只看屏幕、嘴是否敢问、空间是否从未换过、时间是否全是他人安排
modern_applications_en: Organizational creativity audit: run the six-row table on a team — thinking (captured by KPIs), doing (no experiment rights), seeing (never meets users), speaking (no channel), space (never leaves the desk), time (meeting-stuffed) — and unbind item by item.
Designing children's free time: draw the binding inventory before booking enrichment classes — a class that adds bindings is another cram course, the opposite of liberation.
Institutional 'experiment rights' in R&D: codify the right to run experiments, meet customers, and spend 20% of time — with a matching channel to show results.
Personal creativity self-check: is my input one-note, my hands idle, my eyes screenbound, my questions unasked, my space unchanged, my time wholly other-scheduled?

育才学校学生（解放的当事人与证词）
卢梭（'儿童中心'的近代源头）
杜威（'从做中学'的供给端）
modes.key_quote_zh: 解放儿童的头脑，使他能想；解放儿童的双手，使他能干；解放儿童的眼睛，使他能看……解放儿童的空间与时间——创造即在其中。
modes.key_quote_en: Free the child's head, that he may think; free his hands, that he may do; free his eyes, that he may see... free his space and his time — and creation is there.

modes.name_en: Love Without Bounds: Teaching as a Trust
modes.domain_zh: 教育学/教育伦理与人格
modes.domain_en: Education / Ethics and Personhood of the Educator
modes.definition_zh: 陶行知把教育者的职业伦理从'道德劝勉'改写为'信托结构'：'捧着一颗心来，不带半根草去'——教育是受社会的信托经营儿童的未来，教师是受托人，儿童不是工资的交换对象而是信托的受益人。方法论签名有三：其一，利益冲突的不可交易性——他拒绝一切把学生变现的路径（弃教授高薪而办平民学校、拒当教育厅长），因为受托人不得从受托事务中套利；其二，'爱满天下'的普遍性设计——爱不以亲疏、贫富、智愚为界，'你的教鞭下有瓦特，你的冷眼里有牛顿，你的讥笑中有爱迪生'：偏见是信托的挪用，区别对待即违约；其三，人格即课程——教师的人格通过日复一日的行为被学生诵读，'学高为师，身正为范'不是口号而是教材：信托的履行方式本身就是学生学到的最重要内容。这一模式解释了他全部人生选择的一致性：把个人利益从教育交易里彻底移除，不是清高，而是信托结构的完整性要求。
modes.definition_en: Tao rewrote the educator's professional ethics from 'moral exhortation' into a trust structure: 'Come with a whole heart; leave without half a blade of grass' — education is the future of children held in trust from society; the teacher is the trustee; the child is not a counterparty in a wage exchange but the beneficiary of the trust. Three signatures define the mode. First, the non-tradability of conflicts of interest: he refused every path of monetizing students — resigning a professor's salary to run schools for the common people, declining a provincial education ministry post — for a trustee may not arbitrage the trust. Second, universality by design of 'love without bounds': love takes no account of kin, wealth, or cleverness — 'under your pointer sits a Watt; in your cold glance a Newton; in your mockery an Edison' — prejudice is a diversion of trust funds, and differential treatment is breach. Third, personhood as curriculum: the teacher's character is read by students through daily conduct — 'high learning makes the teacher; upright conduct makes the model' is not a slogan but a textbook: the manner in which the trust is performed is itself the most important content the student learns. The mode explains the consistency of his every life choice: stripping personal gain out of the education transaction is not aloofness but the integrity requirement of the trust structure.
modes.source_chapter: 陶行知《捧着一颗心来，不带半根草去》（晓庄封校演说）；《你的教鞭下有瓦特》；育才学校募捐办学生涯（1939-1946）
process_zh: 立信托宣言：办学者/带教者明文写下'受益人是学员的未来，不是机构的营收'，并公示利益冲突排除规则（不推销、不回扣、不区别定价）
做偏见清查：定期检查资源与期待是否按亲疏/背景分层流动——'冷眼与讥笑'是看不见的挪用，须以记录对照
人格行为化：把'身正为范'落成可观察的行为承诺（守时、认错、同吃同住），使人格可被学员核验而非仅被仰望
以终局约束自己：以'不带半根草去'设计退出条款——离任时的利益安排提前公告，防止在任时埋设后路
process_en: Write the trust declaration: the founder or mentor states in writing that the beneficiary is the learner's future, not the institution's revenue, with published conflict-exclusion rules — no selling, no kickbacks, no tiered pricing by favor.
Audit for prejudice: periodically check whether resources and expectations flow in strata by closeness or background — the cold glance and the mockery are invisible diversions; catch them by record.

Behave the personhood: land 'upright conduct makes the model' as observable commitments — punctuality, admitting error, eating and living with learners — so character is verifiable by the taught, not merely admired.
Bind yourself by the ending: design the exit on 'without half a blade of grass' — announce post-tenure arrangements in advance, so no escape route is laid while in office.
representative_cases_zh: 晓庄封校时的演说'捧着一颗心来，不带半根草去'——学校被封他个人分文不取，只带走一身棉衣；此后一生办学校不置私产
育才学校后期经费枯竭，他以'文化 ants'之身四处募捐、卖字卖文，'我自己是叫化子也要办到底'——受托责任优先于个人生计与体面
反面警示：同时期个别学校把'招生'做成生意，学费与录取挂钩、教师向学生推销教材吃回扣——陶行知点名批评'教育商人'：信托挪用一次，信任成本全体教育者分摊；这一批评在今天的教育商业化中反而更显先知
representative_cases_en: At Xiaozhuang's sealing he delivered 'Come with a whole heart; leave without half a blade of grass' — the school closed, he took not a cent, carrying off one padded coat; for the rest of his life he ran schools and owned no property.

In Yucai's lean years he begged nationwide, selling calligraphy and essays — 'even as a beggar myself I will carry this school through' — the trustee's duty outranking personal livelihood and dignity.

Cautionary counterexample: some schools of the era made enrollment a business — fees tied to admission, teachers selling materials for kickbacks. Tao named them 'merchants of education': one diversion of the trust, and the cost of distrust is levied on all educators — a critique that reads prophetic in today's commercialized schooling.
modern_applications_zh: 教育机构的信托条款：把'不以学员为变现对象'写入章程并公示——课程设计与销售提成隔离
导师利益冲突规则：带教者不得要求学生为其私人项目无偿劳动、不得在评审中捞取人情——受托人行为负面清单
慈善与公益的'裸退'设计：项目负责人提前公告离任后的利益安排，防止用项目积累个人筹码
内容创作者的信任账户：免费内容与带货内容严格分离标注，一次混同即计入'挪用'——信任是复利资产
modern_applications_en: Trust clauses for education ventures: write 'learners are not the monetization target' into the charter and publish it — course design walled off from sales commissions.
Mentor conflict rules: a mentor may not conscript students into unpaid private projects or harvest favors in review — a negative list of trustee conduct.
The 'bare exit' in nonprofits: project leads pre-announce post-tenure interests so the project cannot accumulate personal leverage.
The creator's trust account: free content and paid promotion strictly separated and labeled; one commingling counts as a diversion — trust is a compounding asset.

modes.name_en: Great Creation in Ordinary Posts: The Democratization of Achievement
modes.domain_en: Education / Conception of Achievement and Evaluation
modes.definition_zh: 陶行知把'成就'从金字塔尖改写为全谱系：'处处是创造之地，天天是创造之时，人人是创造之人'——伟大不在职业等级的上游而在创造的行动本身；一个改良农具的农夫与一个著书的教授在'创造'这一判据前平等。方法论签名有三：其一，判据置换——评价从'地位/学历/产出量级'换为'是否解决了此前未解决的问题'，判据一换，平凡岗位立即进入成就的计算域；其二，创造的大众供给假设——他不把创造力当作稀缺禀赋而当作普遍潜能，短缺的从来是释放创造的条件（六大解放）而非创造本身，这把'人才问题'改写为'制度问题'；其三，岗位创造的可见化——为平凡劳动提供记录、命名与展示的机制（晓庄的成果展、工学团的发明登记），让'小创造'积累为可传承的公共财富。这一模式与'教鞭下的瓦特'互为表里：伦理上要求平等看见，评价上给出平等的判据——两者合成一套完整的人才民主化工程。
modes.definition_en: Tao rewrote 'achievement' from the pyramid's apex to the whole spectrum: 'everywhere is a place of creation, every day an hour of creation, everyone a person of creation' — greatness lies not upstream in occupational rank but in the act of creating itself; a farmer who improves a plow and a professor who writes a book stand equal before the criterion of creation. Three signatures define the mode. First, criterion swap: evaluation moves from 'status, credentials, output magnitude' to 'did it solve a problem previously unsolved' — swap the criterion and the ordinary post enters the calculus of achievement at once. Second, the mass-supply hypothesis of creativity: creativity is not a scarce endowment but a universal potential; what has always been in shortage are the conditions of release (the six liberations), never creation itself — rewriting 'a problem of talent' into 'a problem of institutions.' Third, making ordinary creation visible: build mechanisms of record, naming, and display for humble labor (Xiaozhuang's exhibitions, the corps' invention registry), so small creations accumulate into transmissible public wealth. The mode and 'the Watt under the pointer' are two sides of one leaf: ethically, the demand to see equally; evaluatively, the criterion that equalizes — together, a complete engineering of the democratization of talent.
modes.source_chapter: 陶行知《创造宣言》（1943）；《第一流的教育家》；晓庄与工学团的成果登记实践
process_zh: 置换评价判据：把'谁做的、什么头衔'从评价输入里剔除，只保留'是否解决此前未解决的问题、是否比旧解更省'两条
做岗位创造普查：在团队/社区里征集每个岗位上的'土办法与小改进'——它们是被评价体系漏掉的创造存量
建登记与展示机制：给小创造命名、记录、可检索（命名权归创造者），使散落的改进可被他人复用与组合
以条件反哺：把资源从'选拔极少数天才'改配为'为多数人创造条件'（工具、时间、许可），验证大众供给假设
process_en: Swap the criterion of evaluation: strip 'who did it and what title' from the inputs; keep only 'does it solve a previously unsolved problem' and 'does it beat the old solution on cost.'
Census ordinary-post creation: collect from every post the 'local methods and small improvements' — the stockpile of creation leaked by the evaluation system.
Build the registry and display: name, record, and make searchable each small creation (naming rights with the creator), so scattered improvements become reusable and combinable by others.
Feed back via conditions: shift resources from 'selecting a few geniuses' to 'supplying conditions for the many' (tools, time, permission), and test the mass-supply hypothesis.
representative_cases_zh: 《创造宣言》的直接靶子是'平凡不能创造'的宿命论：他举例：旷野中的农人从无到有耕出文明——创造不问出身与处境；宣言写成于育才最艰难的1943年，本身就是绝境中的创造示范
晓庄与工学团为'小创造'立档：改良农具、新的记账法、更省柴的灶都被登记命名并在成果展上展示——平凡劳动第一次有了成就的档案
反面警示：他批评'文凭社会'把创造收编为证书的附件——没有证书的创造被看不见，有证书的模仿被高估；其结果是全国最聪明的头脑排队去挤'被承认的窄门'，而广大的创造之地无人耕种
representative_cases_en: The direct target of the 1943 'Declaration of Creation' was the fatalism that 'the ordinary cannot create': a lone farmer in a wilderness can grow civilization from nothing; written in Yucai's hardest year, the declaration is itself a demonstration of creation in extremity.
Xiaozhuang and the corps kept archives for small creations: improved tools, new bookkeeping methods, a fuel-saving stove — registered, named, exhibited; ordinary labor's first files of achievement.

Cautionary counterexample: he attacked the diploma society that annexes creation as an attachment to certificates — uncertified creation invisible, certified imitation overvalued; the result: the nation's cleverest minds queue at the narrow gate of recognition while the vast lands of creation lie untilled.
modern_applications_zh: 组织内部'小创造'登记：把一线改良（更快的小工具、更省的流程）正式登记署名并纳入晋升材料——评价判据从职级转向问题解决
开源世界的贡献平等：判据是 commit 解决了什么问题而非提交者身份——代码评审是最接近陶行知判据的现行制度
社区治理的微创新征集：社区问题不必等顶层方案，居民土办法先征集、命名、推广
个人职业叙事重写：简历从'头衔与年限'改写为'解决了哪些此前未解决的问题'——判据置换后的自我评价
modern_applications_en: An in-house registry of small creations: frontline improvements (a quicker tool, a leaner process) formally registered with the author's name and counted in promotion — criterion moved from rank to problem-solving.
Equality of contribution in open source: the criterion is what the commit solved, not the committer's identity — code review as the living institution closest to Tao's criterion.
Micro-innovation harvest in communities: don't wait for top-down plans; collect, name, and spread residents' field-tested fixes.
Rewriting the personal narrative: the CV moves from 'titles and years' to 'problems previously unsolved that I solved' — self-evaluation after the criterion swap.

modes.key_quote_zh: 处处是创造之地，天天是创造之时，人人是创造之人——平凡的岗位上藏着最大的创造。
modes.key_quote_en: Everywhere is a place of creation, every day an hour of creation, everyone a person of creation — the greatest creations hide in the most ordinary posts.

modes.name_en: The Reverse School: Experimenting from the Village Back to the Ministry
modes.definition_zh: 陶行知的制度创新走的是一条与官僚系统相反的路径：不从教育部发文改起，而从一块田、一个村办起——先做出一个真实运行的'反向样板'（晓庄、工学团、育才），再用样板的实绩去倒逼政策与舆论。方法论签名有三：其一，以运行代替论证——他不写'论乡村教育改造'去说服官僚，而是直接办一所学校让事实说话，'范文'是活的学校而非活的论文；其二，低成本极限设计——每所试验学校都按'几乎无经费'条件设计（破庙起家、师生自建、复利式小先生），这既是贫困的被迫，也是方法论：可复制的制度必须通过贫困测试；其三，传播即试验的延伸——学校的开放、参观者的接待、为学校写文章，都被当作试验的一部分：样板不是终点而是种子。这一模式与晏阳初的定县实验构成 '反向路径' 的两翼：晏以'博士下乡'的专家纵深改造县政，陶以'平民自办'的广度改造学校形态——两人都以运行中的样板对抗纸面改革。
modes.definition_en: Tao's institutional innovation ran a path opposite to the bureaucracy's: not from a ministry circular downward, but from one field, one village upward — first build a genuinely running 'reverse exemplar' (Xiaozhuang, the work-study corps, Yucai), then use the exemplar's living results to push policy and opinion from below. Three signatures define the mode. First, running instead of arguing: he did not write 'On the Reform of Rural Education' to persuade officials — he opened a school and let the facts speak; the living school is the living paper. Second, design at the poverty limit: every experimental school was designed for near-zero funding (a ruined temple for a start, teachers and students building with their hands, the compounding little teachers) — partly poverty's compulsion, partly method: a replicable institution must pass the poverty test. Third, propagation as the experiment's extension: the school's openness, the receiving of visitors, the writing about the school — all counted as part of the trial; the exemplar is not the terminus but the seed. The mode and Yan Yangchu's Ding Xian experiment form the two wings of the reverse path: Yan used the expert depth of 'doctors to the village' to remake county government; Tao used the breadth of 'the common people running their own schools' to remake the school's very form — both opposing paper reform with a running exemplar.
modes.source_chapter: 晓庄师范、山海工学团、育才学校创办实践；《中国乡村教育之根本改造》；陶行知办学书札与经费记录
process_zh: 选最小真实单元起手：从一个村、一所校、一批人开始，禁止以'条件不成熟'推迟到全面方案——可运行的最小单位就是实验单位
按贫困条件设计：把预算上限设为'几乎为零'，一切设计必须通过'没有钱怎么办'的测试——通过贫困测试的制度天然抗风险
做实样板并开放：学校真实运行并接待参观、公开记录与账目——透明的运行本身就是最有力的政策论证
以实绩回写政策：把样板中的可迁移要素写成给决策者的简明建议，用运行证据而非理论压服官僚系统
process_en: Start from the smallest real unit: one village, one school, one cohort — never postpone to a comprehensive plan on 'conditions not ripe'; the smallest runnable unit is the experimental unit.

Design at the poverty condition: set the budget ceiling near zero and require every design to pass the 'no money — now what?' test; institutions that pass the poverty test are risk-proof by construction.
Run the exemplar and keep it open: run the school for real and receive visitors, publishing records and accounts — transparent running is itself the strongest policy argument.
Write policy back from results: distill transferable elements of the exemplar into brief memos for decision-makers — press the bureaucracy with running evidence, not theory.
representative_cases_zh: 晓庄以一座破庙、数百元起家：不领官费、不发文凭、师生自建校舍——经费上限本身成了设计约束，产出却在十年间成为全国教育界朝圣之地
育才学校在抗战流亡中靠募捐维持，仍坚持收容战区难童并按才能分组施教——最穷的条件里跑通'天才儿童教育'的制度原型
反面警示：也有同代改革者走'先拿政策再办学'的路线——方案在部里改了十稿，学校始终未开；陶行知讽刺这类'文件办学'：纸上的学校永远开学不了，因为它欠着'运行'这一门课的学费
representative_cases_en: Xiaozhuang began with a ruined temple and a few hundred yuan: no official funds, no diplomas, teachers and students building with their own hands — the funding ceiling itself became the design constraint, and within a decade the school was a national pilgrimage site.
Yucai, sustained by donations in wartime exile, still admitted refugee children from war zones and streamed them by talent — running the prototype of gifted-child education in the poorest conditions.

Cautionary counterexample: some contemporaries took the route 'secure the policy first, open the school later' — the plan revised ten times in the ministry, the school never opened. Tao mocked such 'paper schools': a school on paper can never hold its opening day, for it has never paid tuition in the one course called 'running.'
modern_applications_zh: 制度创新的最小可运行单元：新管理法先在一个真实团队跑一个季度再谈推广——以运行数据代替可行性论证
产品的贫困测试：新功能按'零预算推广'设计（能否靠口碑与自服务跑起来），通过后才给投放预算
政策试点反向设计：试点不是为证明方案正确而设展示点，而是按最穷县市的真实条件设计并公开账目
社区自治样板：不先争取授权，先把一栋楼的自治跑通并开放参观——样板是最好的请示
modern_applications_en: The smallest runnable unit for institutional innovation: run the new management method in one real team for a quarter before any rollout talk — running data replaces feasibility argument.
The poverty test for products: design the new feature for zero-budget distribution (can it run on word of mouth and self-service?) before granting any ad budget.
Reverse-designed policy pilots: a pilot is not a showcase built to prove the plan right — it is designed for the real conditions of the poorest county, accounts open.
Community self-governance exemplars: don't wait for authorization; run one building's self-governance and let visitors in — the exemplar is the best request for instructions.

modes.key_quote_en: Be friends with horse and ox, sheep and swine, fowl and dog; put your shoulder to rice and millet, wheat and beans — the school lives not on the ministry's paper but in the field's running.

modes.name_en: Democracy as Lifelong Education: The Final Synthesis
modes.domain_zh: 教育学/政治哲学与终局观
modes.domain_en: Education / Political Philosophy and the Endgame
modes.definition_zh: 陶行知晚年（1945-1946）把毕生工作收束为一个终局命题：'民主教育'——教育不只是培养劳动技能的过程，而是训练人人做主人、做创造者的政治实践；'生活教育'与'民主'在他这里不是两个主题而是一体：只有民主的生活才是值得受的教育，只有受过民主教育的人民才守得住民主。方法论签名有三：其一，教育-政体的互为条件——他把专制下的教育诊断为'奴隶教育'（教人服从）与'英才教育'（教人 climbing），两者都生产不配民主也撑不起民主的公民；其二，终身化——'活到老，学到老，做到老'，教育不随毕业终止，因为民主生活本身需要持续学习（议事、监督、协商），一次性的'扫盲'撑不起持续的自治；其三，快与慢的双重时间——他一面推动即时的普及（识字、小先生），一面做长线的种子工程（育才收容天才难童），并清醒地把死亡纳入计划：临终前仍安排文集出版与学校后事。这一模式是他的遗嘱性综合：教育的终点不是就业而是'做自己的主人并使他人也能做主人'——它同时是他对中国现代性最深的判断。
modes.definition_en: In his final years (1945-1946) Tao gathered his life's work into one endgame proposition: 'democratic education' — education is not merely the cultivation of vocational skill but the political practice of training everyone to be a master and a creator; 'life education' and 'democracy' are for him one thing, not two: only a democratic life is an education worth receiving, and only a people schooled in democracy can keep it. Three signatures define the mode. First, education and polity as mutual conditions: he diagnosed education under despotism as 'slave education' (teaching obedience) and 'elite education' (teaching climbing) — both produce citizens unfit for democracy and unable to hold it up. Second, lifelong scale: 'live to be old, learn to be old, do to be old' — education does not end at graduation, for democratic life itself demands continuous learning (deliberation, oversight, negotiation); one-shot literacy cannot sustain self-rule. Third, the double clock of fast and slow: he pushed immediate universalization (literacy, little teachers) while planting long-horizon seeds (Yucai sheltering gifted refugee children), and he coolly planned his own death — arranging his collected works and the schools' future on his deathbed. The mode is his testamentary synthesis: the terminus of education is not employment but 'to be the master of oneself and to enable others to be masters of themselves' — simultaneously his deepest verdict on China's modernity.
modes.source_chapter: 陶行知《民主教育》（1945）；《民主教育之普及》；1946年沪上最后演讲系列与临终安排
process_zh: 做'奴隶教育'诊断：审计现有教育在训练什么——服从还是判断？爬升还是创造？凡答案偏向前者，先改内容再谈规模
把民主写进课程：议事会、选举、账目公开、批评与申诉都成为日常课程而非课外活动——民主是练出来的不是讲出来的
设计终身回路：为毕业者保留继续学习与回校施教的通道（校友即教师），使教育与生活终身互锁
做双重时间规划：每年同时推进一件速效事（普及）与一件慢种事（种子工程），并预先安排'创始人不在时'的制度与文本存续
process_en: Diagnose 'slave education': audit what current schooling actually trains — obedience or judgment? climbing or creating? Where the answer leans former, change the content before scaling.
Write democracy into the curriculum: councils, elections, open accounts, criticism and appeal become daily lessons, not extracurriculars — democracy is trained, not lectured.
Design the lifelong loop: keep channels for graduates to keep learning and to return as teachers — alumni as faculty — locking education and life together for life.
Plan on the double clock: each year advance one fast thing (universalization) and one slow seed (a seedling project), and pre-arrange the institution's and the corpus's survival beyond the founder.
representative_cases_zh: 1945-1946年上海的最后一百天：他连场演讲民主教育，把'生活教育'旗帜正式改写为'民主教育'——在生命终点完成理论的最终命名
育才学校收容战区难童并按才能分组（音乐、戏剧、绘画、文学）——在最坏的时代保存最长的种子：他赌的是战后中国需要这些创造者
反面警示：他批评'民主的化装舞会'——投票仪式齐全而学校里依然不许学生发问、账目依然不公开：民主教育不在选票的仪式里而在日常生活的练习里；没有生活民主的教育民主，终会在第一次危机里露馅
representative_cases_en: The last hundred days in Shanghai, 1945-1946: speech after speech on democratic education, formally renaming 'life education' as 'democratic education' — the theory's final naming completed at the edge of death.

Yucai sheltered refugee children from war zones and streamed them by talent (music, drama, painting, letters) — preserving the longest seeds in the worst of times: he bet that postwar China would need these creators.

Cautionary counterexample: he attacked 'democracy's masquerade' — the voting ritual complete while students in school may not ask questions and the accounts stay shut: democratic education lives not in the ritual of the ballot but in the practice of daily life; educational democracy without lived democracy will show its seams at the first crisis.
modern_applications_zh: 组织民主化课程：把预算公开、提案制、轮值主持做成日常制度练习——民主能力按'练习量'而非'宣言量'积累
终身学习制度设计：为离职员工保留回炉与授课通道（校友教师制），把组织知识变成终身互锁网络
快慢双时钟管理：每个周期同时交付速效项与播种项，并为'创始人离场'预写制度与文档
公民教育的操练化：社区议事、账目公开、罢免演练进日常生活——检验标准是居民是否真在用
modern_applications_en: A curriculum of organizational democracy: open budgets, proposal rights, rotating chairs as daily practice — democratic capacity measured by reps, not declarations.
Lifelong-learning institutions: departed employees keep a channel to return as students and teachers (alumni-faculty), turning organizational knowledge into a lifelong interlocking network.
The double clock: each cycle ships one fast item and one seed item, and pre-writes the institutions and documents for the founder's absence.
Practiced civic education: community deliberation, open accounts, recall drills in daily life — the test is whether residents actually use them.

modes.key_quote_zh: 民主教育是教人做主人，做自己的主人，做国家的主人，做世界的主人——活到老，学到老，做到老。
modes.key_quote_en: Democratic education teaches people to be masters — masters of themselves, of the nation, of the world: live to be old, learn to be old, do to be old.
